parameters.query: SELECT overall_status FROM immich_monitor_state ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (component)
  component, installed_version, available_version, update_type, risk, recommendation,
  security_signal, breaking_change_signal, update_available, source, source_status, checked_at, details
FROM update_advisor_state
ORDER BY component, checked_at DESC;
SELECT component, source_fail_streak, last_event_fingerprint, last_installed_version, last_available_version, last_recommendation FROM update_advisor_meta;
